description.zh: 用于确保实际更改的资源和期望更改的资源是一致的，该值来自[CreateTrigger](~~190054~~)、[GetTrigger](~~190056~~)和[UpdateTrigger](~~190055~~)的响应。
description.en: This parameter is used to ensure that the modified resource is consistent with the resource to be modified. You can obtain the parameter value from the responses of [CreateTrigger](~~190054~~), [GetTrigger](~~190056~~), and [UpdateTrigger](~~190055~~) operations.
